parameters.description: Comma-separated current loop labels; all labels must match.

post.description: Upsert full workflow/loop/run rows by id (idempotent; ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE). Preserves ids, definitions, and timestamps while applying safe defaults: imported workflows are archived, imported loops are paused, and nextRunAt/retryScheduledFor are cleared by default so backfills never schedule immediately. Set preserveWorkflowActivation=true or preserveLoopScheduling=true only for intentional activation. Applied FK-safe: workflows, then loops, then runs. Volatile running runs are skipped and reported.

post.description: Finalize a claimed run. The control-plane receipt time is authoritative for scheduling and updatedAt. A supplied finishedAt is retained only after clamping it between the run start and receipt time; when durationMs is omitted it is derived from the receipt time.

409.description: The runner claim is stale, the run is no longer running, or both bounded loop-advancement attempts lost a concurrent scheduling transition

422.description: The completion status is missing or skipped is not backed by an overlap-skip loop exiting with code 75

status.description: skipped is accepted only for a non-workflow overlap-skip loop whose process exits with code 75.

finishedAt.description: Optional runner evidence timestamp; normalized into [startedAt, server receipt time] before persistence.

durationMs.description: Optional runner-reported duration. When omitted, the server derives elapsed time from startedAt to receipt time.

post.summary: Validate a legacy runner-authored agent session contract
post.description: Compatibility-only runner endpoint. New hosted runners do not call it: the control plane derives and persists agent_session_contract events from stored workflow steps. Non-agent steps, mismatches, duplicates, and fabricated contracts fail closed.

200.description: Validated and persisted only when a compatible pre-change run is still missing its derived event

409.description: Contract mismatch, duplicate, invalid stored workflow, or incompatible pre-change record

422.description: Event type is not allowed, the step is not an agent, or the stored step does not require a contract

409.description: Workflow run is not running, a step process is live, or remote ownership cannot be verified

415.description: Supplied request body is not JSON

422.description: Recovery request body is not a closed reason-only object

200.description: Bounded stuck-run report with opaque reconciliation snapshots

PublicValidationDetails.description: Bounded public metadata emitted only for invalid agent extraArgs. Error messages and argument values are never exposed.

path.description: Sanitized structural path to extraArgs or the invalid indexed entry.

option.description: Sanitized option name only; attached or following values are never included.

storage.description: Server-side storage backend resolved from the environment (HASNA_LOOPS_DATABASE_URL presence).

connection.description: Client connection transport resolved from the environment (HASNA_LOOPS_API_URL + HASNA_LOOPS_API_KEY presence).

expiresAfterRuns.description: Expire the loop after this many consecutive successful runs. Independent of expiresAt.
Expire the loop after this many consecutive successful runs. Independent of expiresAt.
Expire the loop after this many consecutive successful runs. Null clears the ceiling. Independent of expiresAt.

maxAttempts.description: Retry budget for this loop: the scheduler admits a retry while attempt < maxAttempts, so 1 means a single transient failure retires the loop with no retry. Omit to leave the current budget unchanged.

leaseMs.description: Run lease in milliseconds before an unresponsive runner is considered dead. Widen in place for long-running agentic sweeps whose runs legitimately outlive the create-time default (e.g. 4m..1h+ per run). Omit to leave the current lease unchanged.

descriptorRef.description: Private request-only owner-operation-target reference. It is validated before mutation and never serialized in a response.

LoopMutationBinding.description: Public mutation binding projection. The private descriptorRef is replaced by a SHA-256 commitment.

ImportInput.description: Batches of full rows to upsert by id. Any array may be omitted.

replace.description: Update existing rows whose id matches. Default safe imports may still archive/pause same-id workflows/loops when preserve flags are false.

preserveLoopScheduling.description: Default false. When false, imported loops are written paused with nextRunAt and retryScheduledFor cleared so backfills never schedule immediately.

preserveWorkflowActivation.description: Default false. When false, imported workflows are written archived, including same-id active rows, so backfills cannot activate workflow execution unless explicitly requested.

AgentSessionContract.description: Server-derived audit contract for an agent step inside a workflow run. Tool and command restrictions are advisory metadata and are not provider-enforced.

AgentSessionContractEventInput.description: Legacy runner compatibility request. New clients must not fabricate this event; the server derives it.

CustomWorkflowEvent.description: Sanitized backwards-compatible branch for historical or mixed-version custom workflow events.

id.description: Canonical OpenMachines machine id the loop is pinned to.
